title: Multi-Site Credit on Small Business Electricity Supply Agreements: Posting Rule and Care System Tool
content:
For each billing cycle of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement whose plan carries a multi-site credit above zero, one multi-site credit is posted when the business has at least the plan's multi-site minimum of small business sites supplied on the first day of that cycle. A site on a plan whose multi-site credit is zero counts toward the minimum but receives no multi-site credit. A cycle's multi-site credit is posted once that cycle's energy line is billed, so the cycle being credited is the agreement's latest billed cycle.

## Business effect

A multi-site credit line appears on the agreement's bill, tied to the credited cycle, as a reduction of the amount billed. The business sees the multi-site credit on the statement of that cycle's account.

## Tool: `post_multi_site_credit_fd52d0a7`

**Use and capability.** Posts one multi-site bill credit on a small business electricity agreement for one billing cycle: a new credit line is added to the agreement's bill, tied to the billing cycle named, with the credit amount entered as a reduction of the amount billed and today's posting date.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `post_multi_site_credit_fd52d0a7` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bizpower_agreement_id` | the agreement number of the small business electricity agreement credited, as shown on the agreement record returned by the agreement lookup | identifier |
| `billing_period_start` | the start date of the billing cycle the credit belongs to, copied from that cycle's bill lines | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `credit_amount_usd` | the size of the credit in USD; the tool records it as a reduction of the bill | positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent (for example 12.40) |

**Return.** A receipt with `billing_line_id` (the new credit line's reference), `agreement_id` (the agreement credited), `line` (`multi_site_credit`), `cycle_start` (the cycle credited, YYYY-MM-DD), `amount_usd` (the signed line amount, negative, 2 decimals) and `posted_on` (the posting date, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `billing_line_id` means the credit is on the bill.

## Illustration of a call (hypothetical values)

An agreement numbered BP-1001 whose latest billed cycle began on 2026-03-04, credited 12.40 USD: `bizpower_agreement_id` BP-1001, `billing_period_start` 2026-03-04, `credit_amount_usd` 12.40. The receipt shows `amount_usd` as minus 12.40 and the cycle start 2026-03-04.
